title: A Little Push
details:
Two besties, Vicki (Victoria Grant) and Alice (Haven Rose), are catching up when Vicki's boyfriend, Ben (Derek Kage), passes by to head out to work. As he does, there are hints of attraction between him and Alice. After he leaves, Vicki playfully calls out Alice, revealing that Ben and Alice ARE attracted to each other. But Ben is too much of a softie to do anything about it since he doesn't want to do anything that feels like cheating on Vicki.

However, Vicki wants him to be more adventurous, which leads to Vicki and Alice planning a bait and switch scheme. When Ben gets back from work, Vicki suggests that he wear a blindfold for some extra hot sex, which he agrees to. After Vicki blindfolds Ben, Alice takes her place and secretly pleasures him until they finally remove the blindfold and tell Ben the truth. Luckily, after the initial shock, Ben is very into the whole thing, which segues into a lustful threesome.
